concerns.location: plan.md Phase 3 / Tb; spec.md SC-002; contracts/results_schema.schema.yaml (mape_poisson)
concerns.text: MAPE on Poisson's ratio is statistically ill-defined: Poisson's ratio for 2D materials is frequently near zero or negative (auxetics), making |error|/|true| explode or be meaningless. The plan computes mape_poisson and folds it into overall_mape with a weighting scheme. Specify a robust alternative for Poisson (e.g., MAE/RMSE on raw or z-scored values, or MAPE only on |ν|>ε) in tensors.py/eval_runner.py.

concerns.location: plan.md T013d2 / Constitution Principle VI; spec.md Key Entities (C11,C12,C13,C33,C44,C66)
concerns.text: The '6 independent components' filter assumes a specific symmetry class (hexagonal Voigt set C11,C12,C13,C33,C44,C66). A general 2D/layered entry's tensor has different independent sets; filtering on exactly these 6 discards valid entries or mis-parses others. Also, deriving isotropic Young/shear/Poisson via standard 3D continuum relations from a 2D material's tensor requires the in-plane (2D) modulus convention (N/m vs GPa). The plan should state which Voigt-notation convention and which (2D vs 3D) reduction tensors.py implements, and how the filter handles non-hexagonal symmetries.
